descriptionChirho: A proper noun identifying Migdol, an Egyptian frontier town or fortress mentioned in the context of the Exodus route and Jeremiah's prophecies about Jews in Egypt. All occurrences refer to the same geographic location; variation is purely prepositional — locative 'in Migdol' and bare citation form (eng: in Migdol / Migdol, spa: en Migdol / Migdol, hin: में मिगदोल / मिग्दोल, arb: في مِجْدَلَ / مِجْدُولَ, kor: 믹돌) versus ablative 'from Migdol' (eng: from Migdol, spa: desde Migdol, hin: से मिगदोल, swa: kutoka Migdoli).
